artworks.title: Theseus and the Amazons (Aison kylix)
artworks.description: Attic red-figure: Theseus locked with Amazons — the Athenian campaign that answers the abduction of Antiope or Hippolyte.

artworks.title: Theseus in the Amazonomachy
artworks.description: Red-figure Amazonomachy with Theseus among the fighters — Athens' mythic war against the warrior women.

artworks.title: Theseus and Antiope (Athenian Treasury, Delphi)
artworks.description: Delphi metope: Theseus carries off Antiope — the abduction that brings Amazon vengeance to Athens and sires Hippolytus.

artworks.title: The Embassy of Hippolyta to Theseus
artworks.description: Carpaccio's Venetian pageant: Hippolyta's embassy to King Theseus — the Amazon queen and the Athenian hero before war or marriage.

popCulture.title: Penthesilea
popCulture.description: The Amazon queen who dies at Achilles' hand — the Trojan War's most famous Amazon duel.

popCulture.title: Amazon (mythology)
popCulture.description: The warrior women of myth — from Hippolyta's belt to Troy's walls — remain antiquity's emblem of female arms.

popCulture.title: Aethiopis
popCulture.description: The lost epic that brought Penthesilea and Memnon to Troy — Amazon and Aethiopian allies in Achilles' last days.
